list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order (story, then side strands, then activities, then collectibles, then cleanup) and check the Progress menu regularly so nothing is left to the last minute. PowerPyx rates the whole list 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough and no mission replay, so steady progress beats rushing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Play through the story (chapters 1–4 plus the final mission) to bank the 12 story trophies.
Finish the five side characters' final missions and the 8 stranger strands.
Work through the activity and one-off trophies, then the collectibles.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear whatever the checklist still shows.
trophies.tip: Tick trophies off in this guide as you earn them — the progress bar shows how close the platinum is at a glance.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so just play through it — the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first step of chapter 1 and needs no preparation, no collectible and no special approach.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and follow the opening mission's on-screen prompts.
Finish Gone Fishing to the mission-passed screen.
trophies.tip: Nothing to prepare: the opening mission teaches the basics as it goes.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Keep playing the chapter 1 missions in order until the chapter closes — the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. While you are in chapter 1, keep the one missable in mind: the balcony meditation in Positive Mental Attitude can happen in this chapter, so make a manual save at the start of the chapter before you play on.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Make a manual save at the start of chapter 1 (there is no mission replay).
Play every chapter 1 story mission through to the chapter's end.
trophies.tip: Chapter 1 is also where the optional balcony meditation can appear — check the Positive Mental Attitude guide before you leave the chapter behind.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through the chapter 2 missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Make a fresh manual save when the chapter starts, since the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus to fall back on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Make a manual save at the start of chapter 2.
Complete the chapter 2 story missions in order.
trophies.tip: A manual save per chapter is cheap insurance for the whole playthrough.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the chapter 3 missions, including The Cartel Heist, and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 3 also holds a time-sensitive stranger strand: Yago's race shows an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so take it when it appears rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Make a manual save at the start of chapter 3.
Play the chapter 3 missions, including The Cartel Heist, through to the end.
Take Yago's race while its hourglass icon is showing.
trophies.tip: Do not put off the hourglass-marked stranger race in this chapter — timed strands do not wait.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the chapter 4 missions through to the chapter's end and the trophy pops. With the story nearly done, this is a good moment to check the Progress menu: stranger strands and side-character missions still open are easier to finish before the finale than after it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Make a manual save at the start of chapter 4.
Complete the chapter 4 story missions in order.
Before the final mission, sweep up any open stranger or side-character strands.
trophies.tip: Clear open side content before the finale — post-story cleanup is possible, but a tidy run is faster.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy and one of only two golds on the list. Finish the final mission after chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the mission-passed screen. There is no mission replay, so if anything about the finale worries you, make a manual save just before starting it — but the trophy itself cannot be missed by playing the mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before starting the final mission.
Complete the final mission.
trophies.tip: This is the last story trophy — after it, the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats opens up fully.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Breakfast Run is a story mission — play it when it appears in the mission flow and the trophy pops on completion. No special route or loadout is needed; the mission itself is the requirement.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission to its passed screen.
trophies.tip: Story-mission trophies need no grinding — they pop from playing the story.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a chapter 3 story mission — play it through to completion and the trophy pops. Stock up on ammo and armour before the mission starts, since heists tend to run long, but the trophy only asks that the mission is finished.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in chapter 3.
Stock ammo and armour, then complete the mission.
trophies.tip: Heist missions are long — a manual save before starting one costs nothing.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Child's Play is a story mission — complete it when it comes up in the mission flow and the trophy pops at the passed screen. Nothing outside the mission itself is required.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission to its passed screen.
trophies.tip: Named-mission trophies all work the same way: finish the mission, collect the trophy.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Headliners is a story mission — play it through to the passed screen and the trophy pops. As with the other named-mission trophies, there is no side requirement and no way to miss it by playing the story normally.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission to its passed screen.
trophies.tip: If a mission ever feels hard, retrying it is free — there is no penalty for failing and retrying.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around the Vice City airport — complete it and the trophy pops. The airport also matters for a one-off trophy later (Catch Me If You Can, an unscheduled departure from VCIA), so remember the layout once you have seen it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission to its passed screen.
trophies.tip: Note the VCIA layout during this mission — you will come back to the airport for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — complete it and the trophy pops at the passed screen. It is the last of the named-mission trophies, so by the time it pops the story set is nearly done and only the chapter and finale trophies remain.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission to its passed screen.
trophies.tip: With the named missions done, the roadmap moves to side strands and activities.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the second gold. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts toward it — nothing on the checklist is missable. PowerPyx notes the checklist covers only about 60% of true completion and its thresholds are lenient, so it is long rather than brutal: work down the list the game shows you, a section at a time, and the trophy pops when the list hits 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story so the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Open the checklist and work through its sections in order.
Re-check the list after each session — story progress already counts, so the remaining items are the real work.
trophies.tip: Do not chase 100% before the story ends: the checklist itself only appears after the story, and earlier progress is already banked.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and the like all feed the counter the game tracks for you. It is a pure grind trophy: there is no single spot you must use, so fold stunts into normal driving and the count climbs on its own. A fast car, open roads and ramps speed it up; check the Progress menu to see the running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and use jumps, ramps and near misses — each stunt adds to the counter.
Keep a quick car handy and fold stunts into trips you are making anyway.
Check the Progress menu for the running total and grind the remainder after the story.
trophies.tip: 250 sounds like a lot, but stunts happen constantly in normal play — do not grind it until the story is done.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample the game's side activities: try each of the 9 activity types once and the trophy pops. You do not need to win, finish or master any of them — one attempt at each type is enough. Work through the activity icons on the map after the story opens up, and tick each type off as you try it.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and note the different activity icons.
Try one activity of each type — fishing, racing, shooting range, bowling, arcade, drone racing and the rest.
The trophy pops after the ninth distinct type.
trophies.tip: One try is enough — you do not need to win any of the nine.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score, so treat them one at a time: learn the target pattern, pick the weapon the challenge favours, and repeat until the gold threshold is beaten. It is the most skill-heavy trophy on the list after the 100% — expect several attempts on the harder challenges and do them in short sessions rather than one long grind.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Work through the 42 challenges, learning each one's target pattern.
Replay any challenge until its gold medal threshold is beaten.
trophies.tip: Do the ranges in short sessions — accuracy falls off fast when you grind 42 challenges in one sitting.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one rather than 14 wins anywhere. Learn each course's gates and shortcuts, keep the drone low and smooth through turns, and retry a location until the win is banked before moving on.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida (14 in total).
Race each location and win it — a win at every location is required.
Retry any location you lose until its win is banked.
trophies.tip: Finish one location before moving to the next, so you always know which of the 14 are still open.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses count, repeats of one course do not. Work through the race icons on the map, using a fast car suited to each race's surface, and keep count of which courses you have already won. Street, off-road and circuit races all count as long as each win is on a course you have not won before.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the map and pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it with a car suited to the course.
Repeat on new courses until 20 different wins are banked.
trophies.tip: Re-winning a course you already won adds nothing — always pick a fresh course.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the game's activities — learn the casting and reeling rhythm first on ordinary catches, then take Cal on when you are comfortable with it. Beating him once is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Practice fishing on ordinary catches until the reeling rhythm feels natural.
Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Beat his catch to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Practice first — the challenge is much easier once reeling feels automatic.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Find an arcade machine, pick a game and play it to its end — a high score is not required, just a completed run. It is one of the quickest trophies on the list and a good early win while you are learning the activity types.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Start any arcade game and play it through to the end.
trophies.tip: Any arcade game counts — pick the one you find easiest and finish it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Hidden side trophy. Andy is one of the five side characters with a final mission — follow his strand of missions through to the last one and complete it. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so keep checking for Andy's icon on the map between story missions and do his missions when they appear.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Watch for Andy's missions on the map as the story progresses.
Play his strand through in order.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.tip: Side strands unlock gradually — if Andy has no mission showing, play more story and check again.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Hidden side trophy. Kenton is one of the five side characters with a final mission — play his strand of missions through to the last one and complete it. His missions appear on the map as the story advances, so check between story missions and take them when they show up.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Watch for Kenton's missions on the map as the story progresses.
Play his strand through in order.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.tip: Do side missions when they appear — leaving five strands to the end makes cleanup drag.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Hidden side trophy. Billy is one of the five side characters with a final mission — follow his missions through to the last one and complete it. Like the other side strands, his missions unlock as the story moves on, so keep an eye on the map between story beats.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Watch for Billy's missions on the map as the story progresses.
Play his strand through in order.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.tip: Five side characters, five final missions — clearing one strand at a time keeps the map tidy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map — take each strand through to its end, since only completed strands count. One of them is time-sensitive: Yago's chapter 3 race shows an hourglass icon, so do it while it is showing rather than saving it for later.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Sweep the map for stranger icons and start each strand you find.
Play each strand through to its final mission.
Do Yago's chapter 3 race while its hourglass icon is showing.
Finish 8 strands in total.
trophies.tip: The hourglass on Yago's race means timed — never leave a timed strand for later.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Hidden side trophy. Randy is one of the five side characters with a final mission — play his strand through to the last mission and complete it. His missions unlock as the story progresses; check the map between story missions and take them when they appear.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Watch for Randy's missions on the map as the story progresses.
Play his strand through in order.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.tip: Strands and side finals overlap with the story — do them as they unlock, not all at the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Hidden side trophy. Tyrone is the fifth side character with a final mission — follow his strand to its last mission and complete it. Once all five finals are done (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the whole side stage of the roadmap is finished.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Watch for Tyrone's missions on the map as the story progresses.
Play his strand through in order.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.tip: Tyrone's final is the last of the five side finals — after it, move on to activities.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one on the list that can be missed, and the reason for a manual save at the start of every chapter. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and each location must be meditated at as both Jason and Lucia, which counts as 2 per location. The counter in the Progress menu tracks it. The tricky part is in chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia can be found in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept to meditate there. That balcony spot is not marked as a Meditation Spot on the map, and whether it is required for the trophy is still unconfirmed, but the PowerPyx author earned the trophy after doing it, so do it while chapter 1 is still open. With no mission replay, a missed chapter 1 moment cannot be redone without a save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Make a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
In chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Meditate at each of the 18 marked spots as both Jason and Lucia (2 per location, 10 locations).
Check the Progress menu counter after each session so no spot is left behind.
trophies.tip: Do the chapter 1 balcony meditation the moment it is available — it is the one moment in the game that may not come back.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks about. Hunting is a Leonida activity: follow the trail, stay downwind and quiet, and take the shot when it is clean. Bret's request points you at the animal — complete the hunt and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunting request and follow it to the animal's area.
Track the animal quietly and stay downwind.
Take the clean shot to complete the hunt.
trophies.tip: Patience beats speed on a hunt — a spooked animal costs far more time than a slow approach.

trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick up every card you pass and check the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete, then hunt the missing cards for three sets. Sets are finished one card at a time, so this pairs well with exploring the map for the other collectibles.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up every collectible card you find while exploring.
Check the collection screen to see which sets are nearest to complete.
Hunt the missing cards until 3 full sets are finished.
trophies.tip: Do cards alongside the WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries — one sweep of the map feeds three trophies.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations around Leonida. Each new location counts once, so keep moving: visit fresh spots rather than repeating ones you have already done. The counter tracks your total, and the trophy pops at 100 — a long, relaxed sweep of the map rather than anything difficult.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the map and head for areas you have not visited.
WAiNK It at each new location you reach.
Keep sweeping fresh ground until the counter hits 100.
trophies.tip: Pair this with exploring all 52 Leonida areas — the same road trip feeds both trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small side objectives — driving, shooting, exploration and more — and they stack up quickly once you start looking at the challenge list. Open the list, pick the easy ones first to build momentum, then work through the rest; the trophy pops at 50 completed.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenge list and note what is already part-done.
Clear the easiest challenges first to build momentum.
Work through the list until 50 are complete.
trophies.tip: Challenges overlap with everything else on the roadmap — many will complete themselves while you play.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Hidden one-off trophy. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Pick a spot with alleys and cover, break line of sight, and keep moving until the wanted level clears — the trophy pops when you escape with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along and build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and use alleys and cover to lose the pursuit.
Escape with your partner — the trophy pops when the heat is gone.
trophies.tip: Plan the escape route before you raise the wanted level, not while the cops are already on you.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hidden one-off trophy. With your partner, rob three shops in a row — and keep your wanted level alive through all three, so do not lose the cops between robberies. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and keep moving: the trophy pops after the third robbery while the wanted level is still active.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan a fast route between them.
With your partner, rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without losing the heat.
trophies.tip: This is the mirror image of Hot Together: here you must KEEP the wanted level, not lose it.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Simply encountering and registering vehicles as you explore feeds the counter — drive everywhere, try new districts, and hop into anything unfamiliar. It pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas and with registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive through new districts and try unfamiliar vehicles as you find them.
Keep exploring — each new vehicle discovered adds to the counter.
Check the Progress menu until the total hits 100.
trophies.tip: Explore on the way to other objectives: every new district is a fresh batch of vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and take all five down before it ends. Set it up deliberately: find a busy fight, wait until enemies are grouped, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly. Ammo and a good weapon help — do not waste the activation on one or two stragglers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus only when all five are in range.
Take down all five before Combat Focus ends.
trophies.tip: Wait for a grouped fight — triggering Combat Focus on two enemies wastes the attempt.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Hidden one-off trophy. Head to VCIA, the Vice City airport, and leave by an unscheduled departure — in other words, take a plane out without going through the normal departures. You will know the airport's layout from the VCIA Takedown mission; find an aircraft, get it airborne and away from the airport to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA airport, using the layout you learned in VCIA Takedown.
Find an aircraft on the airfield.
Take off and leave the airport — an unscheduled departure.
trophies.tip: Do this after the story, when the airport is freely accessible and you are not mid-mission.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description only hints at Rhinos, the tanks, and the guides cited below have not yet pinned down what the game wants. The sensible approach is tank play: get into a Rhino, cause mayhem with it, and survive in it, and check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger once players have nailed it down. Do not burn hours guessing — this one is best left until the trigger is confirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in Leonida.
Use it in combat and stay alive in it for a good stretch.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger before grinding it.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — try tank play, but wait for a confirmed trigger before grinding.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly: get in, take the goods and get out without any detection. Plan the approach first — quiet entry, no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm — and leave before the store can react. A stealthy loadout and a quick getaway car make the difference between a clean job and a loud one.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout its entrances and sightlines.
Enter quietly, take the goods without tripping an alarm.
Leave undetected with a getaway car ready.
trophies.tip: If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is its own job: plan the entry, crack the vault, grab the take and get clear of the police before the next one. Five escapes are needed, so treat each vault as a full job with its own getaway route rather than rushing from one to the next.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank with a vault you can rob.
Crack the vault, take the money and escape the police.
Repeat at four more banks — five escapes in total.
trophies.tip: A fresh getaway route per vault beats one plan reused five times — the police learn your habits.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it and escape. Trucks move, so intercept one on a quiet stretch, stop it, take the cash and break away before the police close in. A fast getaway car parked nearby turns a good robbery into a clean escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Spot an armored truck on the road and follow it to a quiet stretch.
Stop the truck and take the cash.
Escape the police to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Park the getaway car facing your escape route before you hit the truck.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have set foot in, so sweep it district by district — cities, beaches, swamps, small towns and the spaces between them. It pairs perfectly with the WAiNK locations, the vehicle discoveries and the card hunt: one long road trip feeds all of them.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note which of the 52 areas are still unvisited.
Drive or fly through the missing areas, setting foot in each one.
Check the map until every area is marked explored.
trophies.tip: Do this sweep last in the collectibles stage — by then most areas will already be visited.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit an illegal operation run by each of the 9 gangs in Leonida — one per gang, nine in total. Learn which operations belong to which gang, plan each hit, and keep count so no gang is done twice while another is still untouched. The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn which illegal operations belong to which of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang, keeping count.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation.
trophies.tip: Keep a written list of gangs done — nine similar hits blur together fast.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but which bar, seat or moment the game wants has not been pinned down yet. The sensible approach is to visit the Ocean Beach bars, take a seat with a sea view and order a cocktail, then check the cited guides once players have confirmed the precise spot. Do not grind it blind.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and look for its bars with a sea view.
Take a seat with a view and order a cocktail.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed spot before repeating it.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — one relaxed visit now, and a confirmed spot later.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style, but which showroom and what counts as the smash have not been pinned down yet. The sensible approach is to drive a car through a showroom's frontage and out the other side, then check the cited guides once players have confirmed the precise showroom and method. Do not grind it blind.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Pick a vehicle showroom and line up a fast approach.
Drive through the showroom frontage and out in classic style.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed showroom and method.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — try one showroom, then wait for the confirmed method.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to its end. Bowling is one of the game's activities, so the lane, the ball and the follow-through are all part of the visit; a full game at that specific alley is what the trophy asks for.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling there.
Play it through to the end — follow-through included.
trophies.tip: Use this alley specifically — other lanes will not count for this trophy.

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and the precise trigger is not spelled out by the trophy text. It reads as a partner-activity trophy: spend time on shared activities with your partner that draw a crowd or build a following, and check the cited guides for what players have found pops it. Treat it as a late-cleanup trophy rather than one to chase early.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play partner activities that build a crowd or a following.
Keep at them across sessions — this one is about a partnership, not one stunt.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.tip: Vague description, so leave it to cleanup and confirm the trigger first.

trophies.guide: Make 500 profile-changing actions — the small choices that shift how the game sees Jason and Lucia. The counter builds up across the whole playthrough from ordinary decisions, so it mostly takes care of itself by the end of a full run. One warning matters: do not push your profile toward Irredeemable, which is permanent. Play normally, make choices as they come, and let the count reach 500 on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play normally and make the profile-changing choices the game offers.
Let the counter build across the playthrough — 500 is a whole-game total.
Check the Progress menu for the running count in cleanup.
trophies.tip: Never push toward the Irredeemable profile — that change is permanent.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but what that something is has not been pinned down yet. The sensible reading is a retry: fail an activity or challenge once, then succeed on the immediate second try. Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger before spending time on it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Pick an activity you can retry quickly.
Fail it once, then succeed on the second attempt.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — a quick retry test costs little, but do not grind it blind.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description reads like witnessing something strange or unexplained in Leonida, but which event the game wants has not been pinned down yet. Keep playing, keep an eye out for odd encounters, and check the cited guides once players have found the event that pops it. This is a wait-for-confirmation trophy, not a grind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Keep playing and exploring — strange encounters turn up in the open world.
When something odd happens, stay with it to its end.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed event.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — explore widely and let the event find you.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch — the description points at knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the precise speed, weapon and target have not been pinned down yet. The sensible approach is a slow drive-by with a melee weapon swung from the car window at a pedestrian, then check the cited guides for the confirmed method before repeating it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car, and find a quiet street.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing the melee weapon from the window.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed method.
trophies.tip: Trigger unconfirmed at launch — one test run, then wait for the confirmed method.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — they are not clean cash until laundered, so feed them through your contacts a batch at a time and watch the laundered total climb. The bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies on this roadmap all produce marked bills, so the total builds while you do the other money trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob vaults, trucks and shops to build up marked bills.
Launder them through your contacts in batches.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered.
trophies.tip: Launder as you go — sitting on a pile of marked bills helps nobody.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Weapons, ammo, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so this is really a spending total for the whole playthrough — buy what you need as you need it and the total climbs on its own. If it is still short in cleanup, top it up with a big purchase such as a car or a weapon upgrade.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy weapons, ammo, clothes and upgrades as you play.
Keep the receipts in mind — every shop purchase counts.
Top up with a big purchase in cleanup if the total is still short.
trophies.tip: Do not save-spend: normal shopping across a full playthrough gets most of the way there.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money and give you somewhere to store vehicles, so they are useful as well as required. Find each garage for sale on the map, buy it, and repeat until all eight are yours — the trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find the garages for sale across Leonida (8 in total).
Buy each one as you can afford it.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
trophies.tip: Buy garages as you find them — spreading the cost across the playthrough is easier than eight at once.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you have discovered, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten registrations is all it takes. It pairs with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the interesting ones as you find them and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Discover vehicles while exploring Leonida.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register each new find.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
trophies.tip: Register as you discover — ten registrations arrive fast when paired with the 100-vehicle hunt.
